doc.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Teaching at an adult jazz camp in San Diego
summary: He teaches older drumming styles at the America's Finest City Dixieland Jazz Society camp.

venues.name: America's Finest City Dixieland Jazz Society jazz camp

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: You’ve been involved in some jazz education projects?

Yes. San Diego, the America’s Finest City Dixieland Jazz Society has an adult jazz camp with instruction on cornet, trombone, reeds, piano, banjo, bass instruments and drums. And I’ve done one of those and was scheduled for a second and then had to go on one of these tours so I missed it. But I’ll be doing it again this coming January. And I teach the older techniques: New Orleans, Chicago and the San Francisco/New Orleans revival style that I mentioned earlier.
